notes: A fix pass, mostly for Windows. On the desktop app your add-ons, profile, settings and progress now survive closing it, files with several audio tracks offer the choice under Audio, a video file dropped on the window plays, the stock menu bar and its shortcuts are gone, F11 goes fullscreen like the f key, and closing mid-playback saves your place first. Everywhere: stream rows an add-on marks as not playable in a browser say so and sit below the rest, a stream that cannot play explains itself in words, audio tracks are named by language, and watch parties always reach the relay that is running.
